drivingQuestion: Why is one who says 'my mouth like his mouth, my hair like his hair' a nazirite?
outcomeNote: The question is developed and answered in the following unit (nazir.sugya078).

segments.he: ״הֲרֵינִי נָזִיר״, וְשָׁמַע חֲבֵירוֹ וְאָמַר ״פִּי כְּפִיו וּשְׂעָרִי כִּשְׂעָרוֹ וְכוּ׳״. מִשּׁוּם דְּאָמַר ״פִּי כְּפִיו וּשְׂעָרִי כִּשְׂעָרוֹ״ הֲרֵי נָזִיר?
segments.en: § The mishna taught that one stated: «I am hereby a nazirite, and» if «another heard and said, my mouth is like his mouth, and my hair is like his hair,» he is a nazirite. The Gemara asks: Just «because he said: My mouth is like his mouth and my hair is like his hair,» is «he a nazirite?»
